scope.title: Idea & scope
scope.text: We start with your idea, not with code: who it is for, what they do in the app, and what can wait for version two.
scope.get: A written scope and a price range for it.

wire.title: Wireframes
wire.text: Every screen as gray boxes first, so you can tap through the whole flow on your own phone before anything is drawn.
wire.get: A clickable prototype, the technical specification and a fixed price.

design.title: Design
design.text: Colors, type and icons, in light and dark mode. Design stays a week or two ahead of the code, so nobody waits.
design.get: Every screen in its final look, ready to build.

build.title: Build
build.text: One codebase (React Native) runs on iPhone and Android, so you pay for one app, not two. The server, payments and maps are built alongside.
build.get: A new version on your phone every week and a short written update every day.

test.title: Test on real devices
test.text: Small and large phones, old and new, on slow networks too. Crash reports are on from the first test build, so we catch problems before your customers do.
test.get: A version real people have already used, ready for the stores.

release.title: Store release
release.text: We prepare the listings, screenshots and privacy forms and take the app through App Store and Google Play review.
release.get: Your app in both stores, with the code and accounts in your name and 12 months of bug fixes.
